verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a Test Drive sandbox plan giving access to all API endpoints, an OpenAPI spec used to generate a client library for testing, and an MCP toolkit that can dynamically generate 'working code examples based on current API specifications' for AI tools — all suggesting some runnable/interactive exploration exists. However, there is no explicit mention of an interactive API reference page (e.g., Swagger/Redoc-style 'try it now' console) embedded in the docs themselves. Missing for 10: direct evidence of an in-browser interactive API reference with executable request/response examples, and independent confirmation of its usability.
